_about: Famous haunted sites, chosen by hand. Each must be told in a public-domain book: 'quote' must appear word for word in one story (checked by scripts/sites.py). Location comes from the gazetteer by 'name' in 'county'; only where the gazetteer has no entry are coordinates given, with their source.
